name: StartupError
description: Full-window notice shown when the app fails to initialise, with the error text and a link to the issue tracker.

props.name: error
props.description: The rejection from initialization.init(). An Error renders its message and stack; anything else renders String(error).

notes: Figma is not linked yet. Rendered by App.svelte's {:catch} branch before any store has loaded, so it renders from props alone and does not read stores or bindings. The issues link hands off to openExternal on click but keeps a plain href as a fallback in case the Wails runtime is what failed.
